messages:
sara: Quick sync — we need a facilitator for the postmortem on last night's write-errors outage. Customer-facing impact, want to run this next week so actions land early. Who can take facil?
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260316 created — summary: write errors to /api/v1/ingest for ~22m, 3 tenants saw elevated 5xx, autoscaling did not fully absorb spike. Postmortem template: https://redwood.internal/incidents/templates/postmortem
mike: I can facilitate Tue 10:00 PT. Happy to run it. :hand:
jen: I can make Wed 15:00 PT, prefer attendee.
sam: I did the live mitigation (scaled workers + temporary rate-limit). I can prep the timeline and logs. Tue or Wed works for me.
sara: Prefer Tue to surface actions faster. Agenda: timeline, root cause hypotheses, mitigation review, action items + owners.
mike: ok i'll take facil. I'll send calendar invite with doc links and recording.
sara: thanks — main asks for attendees before the meeting: timeline, error-rate graphs, reproducer notes, and mitigation commands. Also need someone to own customer comms draft.
jen: I can own customer comms draft (ETA EOD Wed).
sam: I'll own the ops follow-up to add a circuit-breaker and a canary rollback test (ETA 2 weeks for initial PR).
sara: please add these to the postmortem doc as "Action: <owner> — <item> — ETA" so our automation picks them up. Also include any follow-up playbook snippets.
mike: invite will include this short checklist. Adding now: ```
- Pre-read: /shared/incidents/INC-20260316/timeline.md
- Attach: server logs (s3://redwood-incidents/INC-20260316/logs)
- Duration: 45m
- Expected attendees: eng-oncall, infra, product, support
- Recording: yes
```
jen: can we also add a one-slide customer-impact summary for the top-of-meeting? helps product & support. :thumbsup:
sara: yes — product/support please add a 1-slide summary to the pre-read.
alex: I'll add customer IDs and the impact summary to the pre-read doc (support side).
sam: quick note for data — we should include kv-cache hit-rate before/after the mitigation. I'll add a short data task to the doc.
mike: calendar invite sent: Tue 2026-03-24 10:00 PDT / 17:00 UTC. Zoom + recording included. Doodle (timezone backup): https://doodle.com/abc123
sara: RSVP guidance: if you can attend in-person for discussion, mark yes; if you only want notes, mark maybe but add a comment.
jen: RSVP'd yes.
alex: attending, will bring customer impact write-up.
sara: Owners recap: Facilitator: mike; Timeline + mitigation notes: sam; Customer comms: jen; Data validation: sam; Postmortem writeup: sara. If you need to swap, ping me or the incident channel.
mike: I'll run a 10m start-of-postmortem checklist then dive into timeline. Will capture actions live and assign.
sara: Great — please include the rollback steps and canary test doc in the pre-read so we can review mitigation durability.
mike: will do. Also enabling recording and notes PR in the doc for synchronous capture.
sara: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread — calendar invite + postmortem doc links are in the invite. :white_check_mark:
